predictions.articleTitle: Vejle vs HB Koge Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Depleted Visitors Breach Home Fortress?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Second-placed Vejle are backed to defeat an injury-hit and suspension-weakened HB Koge side in regulation time behind Mikkel Duelund and Tobias Bach.
possibilityAssessment: Vejle Home Win driven by 1.86 goals/match output and HB Koge's 14.3% clean-sheet rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS Yes anchored by 3.14 combined lambda and 71.4% venue Over 2.5 splits (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
2:0 Home Shutout secondary branch if Vejle's recent 3-in-4 clean-sheet run holds against depleted visitors (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Duelund and Bach target an HB Koge defense missing suspended Larsen.

spf.comment: Backed by a 2:1 primary projection as Vejle's 1.86 goals-per-game home attack exploits an HB Koge squad missing suspended Gabriel Larsen and five injured players.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.14 combined goal expectancy (60.7% Poisson Over 2.5) and identical 71.4% Over 2.5 rates in Vejle's home and HB Koge's away league fixtures.

btts.comment: HB Koge have scored in five consecutive matches (72.2% Poisson scoring probability) against a Vejle side with just two clean sheets in seven home league games.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Vejle's superior attack meeting HB Koge's five-match scoring streak, while 2:0 covers Vejle's recent defensive tightening and July's 2:0 H2H result.

goals.comment: 3 goals (22.3% Poisson density) and 2 goals (21.3%) represent the two most probable scoring totals across the 2:1 primary and 2:0 secondary scripts.
